arguments.query: A complete whole-model spotting receipt cannot be applied when its plans carry many rejection rows (16 MiB params cap; preview-receipt refuses untruncated receipts)

report.title: A complete whole-model spotting receipt cannot be applied when its plans carry many rejection rows (16 MiB params cap; preview-receipt refuses untruncated receipts)
report.detail: Observed: plan_whole_model_spotting with settings.max_reported_rejections 20000 (the Nyamagabe B settings) returned 34 planned, untruncated plans totalling 233 MiB, 228 MiB of it plan.rejected diagnostics. spotting_layout_application takes the plans as --params, capped at 16 MiB (params_too_large), and the plans cannot be trimmed without breaking their digests. ds dsgrid spotting preview-receipt refuses the same receipt with receipt_truncation_scope (truncation_count 0) because it only accepts receipts truncated in rejected rows. So there is no apply path for a valid, complete receipt; the only way out was a second 10-minute run with max_reported_rejections 32, which gave byte-identical layouts. Expected: a verified plan can be applied however large its diagnostics are, e.g. spotting_layout_application reads plans from the receipt file (digest-verified, diagnostics ignored), or the planner refuses/warns up front when max_reported_rejections would exceed the apply bound. Acceptance: the attempt-2 receipt below applies to m2-prep2.dsgrid without a re-run.
report.blocked_on: Version-qualified replay of original attempt-2 sealed plans: recorded rev:c3b80112...aab66 differs from current canonical open rev:58fa3bfa...40fd despite exact source SHA.

The installed apply-receipt dry run accepts the size but refuses receipt_revision_mismatch: sealed rev:c3b80112...aab66 versus opened source rev:58fa3bfa...40fd despite exact package SHA. No apply/output/replan was attempted; original package, raw and compressed receipt remain unchanged. Exact acceptance still requires version-qualified replay of these sealed plans against their recorded canonical revision, preserving all source/revision/plan digest guards.
